title: EchoDiST: Self-distillation-based joint learning for diffusion-conditioned echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation
title_zh: EchoDiST: 自我蒸馏为基础的联合学习框架，用于扩散条件下的心脏超声心肌运动估计

paragraphs.en: EchoDiST 是一种基于自我蒸馏联合学习的心脏超声心肌运动估计框架，适用于无监督学习场景。 Motion estimation in echocardiography is essential for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and myocardial mechanics, but remains challenging due to image artifacts, limited image information, speckle decorrelation, and the scarcity of ground-truth displacement fields. Anatomy-guided approaches can provide structural information, yet often rely on expert-labeled myocardial segmentations. We propose EchoDiST, a framework for unsupervised echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation that integrates self-distillation-based joint learning with a diffusion-conditioned motion estimation network. Here, unsupervised motion estimation refers to learning without ground-truth displacement fields. The self-distillation strategy jointly optimizes anatomical segmentation and myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical annotations. Diffusion-based conditioning is used during training with stochastic perturbations, while inference requires only a single deterministic forward pass without iterative reverse-diffusion sampling. EchoDiST was evaluated on three echocardiographic datasets, including two external test datasets under cross-view and cross-dataset settings. Compared with seven representative learning-based methods, EchoDiST consistently improved anatomical alignment, myocardial strain assessment, and motion-derived functional and cardiac-phase assessment. These gains were statistically significant across the evaluated tasks and datasets. Overall, EchoDiST provides an effective approach for reliable myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical supervision and supports downstream quantitative assessment of cardiac function.
paragraphs.zh: EchoDiST 是一种基于自蒸馏联合学习的心脏超声心肌运动估计框架，适用于无监督学习场景。超声心动图运动估计对于心脏功能和心肌力学的定量评估至关重要，但由于图像伪影、图像信息有限、斑点失相关以及真实位移场稀缺等问题，这一任务仍然充满挑战。 基于解剖结构的引导方法能够提供结构信息，但通常依赖专家标注的心肌分割结果。 我们提出了 EchoDiST，一种用于无监督超声心动图心肌运动估计的框架，它将自蒸馏联合学习与扩散条件化运动估计网络相结合。 此处的无监督运动估计指的是在没有真实位移场的情况下进行学习。 在解剖学标注有限的情况下，自蒸馏策略能够同时优化解剖结构分割和心肌运动估计。 训练过程中采用基于扩散的条件化方法并引入随机扰动，而推理阶段仅需一次确定性前向传播，无需迭代反向扩散采样。 我们在三个超声心动图数据集上对 EchoDiST 进行了评估，其中包括在跨视角和跨数据集设置下的两个外部测试数据集。 与七种代表性的基于学习的方法相比，EchoDiST 在解剖结构对齐、心肌应变评估以及基于运动的功能和心脏相位评估方面均表现出持续改进。 这些改进在评估的各项任务和数据集上均具有统计学显著性。 总体而言，EchoDiST 提供了一种有效的方案，能够在有限的解剖学监督下实现可靠的心肌运动估计，并支持后续的心脏功能定量评估。
